# OpenAgents

> Open-source agent infrastructure whose public service is a keyed HTTP
> decision API: a caller posts one state and a map of typed questions
> (`noul`, `choice`, `score`) and receives one typed answer per question
> with probabilities. Batch classification runs through `POST
> /v1/classify` and durable jobs through `POST /v1/jobs`. This file
> indexes the machine-readable discovery documents an agent needs; each
> describes what the code implements today, and the catalog names what
> it does not.

## Discovery documents

- [agents.md](agents.md): The agent-facing entry document — what the service is, where to start, and the honest limits.
- [index.json](index.json): Versioned index of every file in this discovery set, with a content note per file.
- [api-catalog.json](api-catalog.json): The route catalog — every HTTP route the gateway implements including the public discovery and docs API surface, request and answer shapes, refusal codes, and an explicit list of advertised surfaces that do not exist yet.
- [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml): An OpenAPI 3.1 fragment covering exactly the implemented API routes and their real request/response schemas.
- [auth.md](auth.md): How a caller authenticates — `oak_` bearer keys and `sess_` session tokens, where they may live, the self-serve sign-up surface on accounts deployments, and the typed refusal a rejected call gets.
- [skills.md](skills.md): What an agent needs to call the API — the `oak` CLI, the `oak-mcp`/`oak-mcp-http` MCP servers, or raw HTTP — plus supported versions and honest limits.
- [mcp-tools.json](mcp-tools.json): The MCP tool list snapshot the mirrored server card serves; the live card answers at `GET /mcp/card` on the `oak-mcp-http` listener.

## Served at the origin

`GET /api` is the API index; `/.well-known/agent-card.json` is the
A2A-format agent card; `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` is the
agent-skills discovery index with digested artifacts; `/mcp/server-card.json`
mirrors the MCP server card; `GET /v1/docs` is the versioned docs API
(list/read/search/examples, no credential); `/plugins/` serves the
declarative Claude- and Codex-compatible plugin packages.

## Reference

- [README.md](README.md): The general agent architecture this repository builds toward.
- [roadmap.md](roadmap.md): Remaining design and implementation work for general agents.
- [Caller guide](../decision-models/guides/caller.md): The end-to-end guide to calling the decision API.
- [Classification callers](../decision-models/guides/classification-callers.md): The `oak classify` and `oak-mcp` caller contract.
- [MCP server guide](../decision-models/guides/mcp-server.md): The Streamable HTTP transport — sessions, protocol versions, per-request bearer forwarding.
- [Gateway service document](../decision-models/service/gateway.md): The implemented admission path, bounds, and refusal codes.
- [Durable jobs](../decision-models/service/durable-jobs.md): The job submission, status, cancellation, export, and webhook contract.
- [Decision API specification](../decision-models/api/decision-api.md): The target product contract, including surfaces that are not implemented.
